* **Note:** VHH duplicates are *not* well-tracked in the outlier group, which may lead to differences in CDR3 observed in `Most-frequent CDR3` relative to `Most-frequent VHH`.

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
# * **Note:** VHH duplicates are *not* well-tracked in the outlier group, which may lead to differences in CDR3 observed in `Most-frequent CDR3` relative to `Most-frequent VHH`.

root_dir <- "~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/phylogenetic_dbs/translated_dbs/culled_databases/"
#root_dir <- "~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/phylogenetic_dbs/"

# ~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/phylogenetic_dbs/translated_dbs/culled_databases/GS_NGO0265_d2VHH_09Jul24-Cleaned19Apr24.csv

# Global Set Experiment 
# input_file <- "GS_NGO1549_d2VHH_09Jul24-Cleaned19Apr24.csv"
input_file <- "GS_NGO0265_d2VHH_09Jul24-Cleaned19Apr24.csv"


# Not working(?) Invalid "times" argument (duplicate_count?) (in unroll_dupes_fast)
#input_file <- "13_VecF1_R2_S13-Cleaned19Apr24.csv"

#[1] "09_S18-Cleaned15May24.csv" "10_S19-Cleaned15May24.csv" "11_S20-Cleaned15May24.csv" "12_S21-Cleaned15May24.csv" "33_S7-Cleaned15May24.csv" 
#[6] "34_S8-Cleaned15May24.csv"  "35_S9-Cleaned15May24.csv"  "37_S11-Cleaned15May24.csv" "41_S16-Cleaned15May24.csv"

results <- read.csv(paste(root_dir, input_file, sep = ''), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

tmp_res <- data.frame()

for (nm in unique(results$clone_id)){
  tmp_frame <- results[results$clone_id == nm,]
  if (length(unique(tmp_frame$group)) == 2){
    tmp_frame$group <- rep("mixed", each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  }
  tmp_res <- rbind(tmp_res, tmp_frame)
}

results <- tmp_res

rm(tmp_res)

# Imports
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggseqlogo))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(stringdist))
```

```{r, echo = F, eval = T, warning = F}
seqs <- data.frame()

for (nm in unique(results$clone_id)){
  tmp_frame <- results[results$clone_id == nm,]
  # Pull most frequent VHH
  most_abundant_VHH <- tmp_frame[which.max(tmp_frame$duplicate_count),]$VHH
  clone_id <- tmp_frame[which.max(tmp_frame$duplicate_count),]$clone_id
  CDR3 <- tmp_frame[which.max(tmp_frame$duplicate_count),]$junction_aa
  duplicate_count <- tmp_frame[which.max(tmp_frame$duplicate_count),]$duplicate_count
  centroid_id <- tmp_frame[which.max(tmp_frame$duplicate_count),]$centroid_id
  
  seqs <- rbind(seqs, cbind(clone_id, centroid_id, most_abundant_VHH, CDR3, duplicate_count))
}


# Pull sequences
sequences <- Biostrings::AAStringSet(seqs$most_abundant_VHH)
# Add names
names(sequences) <- seqs$clone_id
# Perform multiple sequence alignment
msa_result <- msa::msa(sequences, method = "ClustalOmega", order = "input")
# Store aligned results
seqs$aligned_VHHs <- as.character(msa_result@unmasked)
# Gsub for readability
seqs$aligned_VHHs <- gsub("-", "_", seqs$aligned_VHHs)
# Convert duplicate count to numeric
seqs$duplicate_count <- as.numeric(seqs$duplicate_count)

seqs <- seqs[order(seqs$duplicate_count, decreasing = T),]

write.csv(seqs, file = paste("~/Downloads/GS-Families-Aligned-Experiment-", input_file, sep = ''), row.names = F)
```

```{r, echo = F, eval = F, warning = F}
counts <- 1

tmp_res <- seqs[seqs$duplicate_count >= counts,]

strings <- tmp_res$most_abundant_VHH

CDR3s <- tmp_res$CDR3

# Compute the distance matrix using
dist_matrix <- stringdistmatrix(strings, method = "lv")

# Perform hierarchical clustering
cluster_tree <- hclust(as.dist(dist_matrix), method = "complete")

# ordering <- order.dendrogram(as.dendrogram(cluster_tree))

main_title <- paste("Cluster Dendrogram of CDR3 families from ", gsub("-Cleaned19Apr24.csv", "", input_file),"\nDemand >= ", counts," VHHs, Distance Metric: Levenshtein", sep = '')

tmp_res <- tmp_res[cluster_tree$order,]

write.csv(tmp_res, file = paste("~/Downloads/GS-CoV-HCLUST-ORDERED-",input_file, sep = ''), row.names = F)

par(family = "Courier")

# Plot the dendrogram with labels
plot(cluster_tree, main = main_title, xlab = "VHH Count-Clonal Family-Subfamily-CDR3", sub = NULL, 
     labels = paste(tmp_res$duplicate_count,'-C', tmp_res$clone_id, '-SF', tmp_res$centroid_id,'-',tmp_res$CDR3, sep = ''), 
     ylab = "Distance (Levenshtein)", 
     cex = 0.75)
```

## Database Statistics

```{r, echo = F, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, eval = T, warning=F}
unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(results, "VHH")
unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(results, "junction_aa")
# Pull statistics
median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])

if (TRUE){
cat("Database: ", input_file, '\n', sep = '')#gsub("_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv", "",results$source_file[1]), '\n', sep = '')
cat("Overall Members (Including Duplicate DNA Reads): ", sum(results$duplicate_count), '\n', sep = '')
cat("Number of Clonal Families: ", length(unique(results$clone_id)), '\n', sep = '')
cat("Number of Sub-families: ", length(unique(results$centroid_id)), '\n', sep = '')
cat("Unique VHHs (Amino Acid-level): ", length(unique(results$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
cat("Unique CDR3s (Amino Acid-level): ", length(unique(results$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", median_CDR3, '\n', sep = '')
cat("Most-frequent VHH: ", median_VHH, '\n', sep = '')
cat("VHH's by Grouping:\n")
print(table(results$group))
cat("Clonal Family Membership Statistics:\n")
print(summary(as.numeric(table(results$clone_id))))
cat("Clonal Subfamily Membership Statistics:\n")
print(summary(as.numeric(table(results$centroid_id))))
cat("Clonal Family Representation (clone_id on top, count on bottom):\n")
print(top_groups(results, "clone_id"))
}
```


### Logo Plots (Ordered by Unique VHH Abundance in Clonal Families)

```{r, echo = F, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, eval = T, warning=F}
tab <- top_groups(results, "clone_id")

for (nm in head(names(tab), 100)){
  tmp_frame <- results[results$clone_id == nm,]
  unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
  # Pull statistics
  median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
  median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
  
  if (length(unique(tmp_frame$group)) == 2){
    tmp_frame$group <- rep("mixed", each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  }
# unique(substr(input_file, 1, 2)),'-'
  if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
      cat(paste('Family: ',unique(tmp_frame$clone_id), '\n', sep = ''))
      cat(paste("Group: ", unique(tmp_frame$group)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Overall Members (Including Duplicate DNA Reads): ", sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Number of Sub-families: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$centroid_id)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", median_CDR3, '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most-frequent VHH: ", median_VHH, '\n', sep = '')
      print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
        theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", median_CDR3, sep = '')))
  }
}
```
